request: Make a promo film for LitCodex, the lit workflow plugin for Codex CLI, to sit in its GitHub README.
pathReason: The film needs a drawn goal card, a progress ring, a handoff sheet and a terminal prompt, which are shapes and diagrams beyond type.
idea: One small task travels from a typed lit through checks that must earn their green and a handoff, so the next session can finish it.
audience: Developers who work in Codex CLI and lose the thread between sessions.
channel: GitHub README section and link previews
formatReason: The README column and video players are landscape.

beats.purpose: Hook: the one word a person types
beats.onScreen: Headline Add lit to a request with lit in orange; a prompt bar types a lit request; the five-row LIT mark builds in an outlined transcript frame
beats.motion: Words rise through a mask; the typed lit ignites the headline word; mark rows stagger in
beats.sound: Pad and pulse from the first quarter second; a rise toward the end of the beat

beats.purpose: The request becomes a goal with checks
beats.onScreen: Headline A request becomes a goal; a goal card unfolds with four unchecked checks and a progress ring drawing in
beats.motion: Mark lifts away, card wipes open from the top, rows slide in on a stagger, ring draws on
beats.sound: Hit on the cut into the goal card

beats.purpose: Checks earn green only with evidence; a blocker stays open
beats.onScreen: Headline Green needs evidence; three checks turn lime with evidence tags and the ring fills three quarters; the fourth stays orange and open
beats.motion: Check marks draw on one after another, ring segments fill in step, the open row holds a steady orange outline
beats.sound: Hit on the cut into the checks; a rise into the open check

beats.purpose: Handoff carries the unfinished work forward
beats.onScreen: Headline Say handoff; the prompt bar types handoff; a paper handoff sheet with Decisions, Remaining work and Where to resume slides over the card and is filed into the prompt bar
beats.motion: Sheet slides in with a slight tilt, its rows draw, then it drops into the bar as the right side clears
beats.sound: Hit on the cut into the handoff

beats.purpose: A new session resumes and closes the open check
beats.onScreen: Headline Next session, same place; a fresh prompt asks to read the handoff and continue; the sheet is read, the card returns with three green checks, and the fourth turns lime as the ring completes
beats.motion: Bar wipes clean, sheet rises and is read line by line, card returns, final check draws on and ring closes
beats.sound: Hit on the cut into the new session

beats.onScreen: A complete four-segment ring holds the LIT mark; the prompt bar runs doctor and prints All checks passed; LitCodex and Keep the work lit settle
beats.motion: Card collapses into the large ring, doctor line types, wordmark rises through a mask
beats.sound: Cadence: a struck tonic chord to close the film

subject.name: The lit loop on a signup form task
specifics: A goal card with four checks that can pass or fail, and a progress ring that fills only when evidence is recorded
One check stays open across a handoff and closes in the next session

typePlan.hierarchy: Archivo 900 headline at 108 to 250 px, Archivo 400 support line at 40 to 44 px, MesloLGS NF for the prompt, mark and evidence tags

palette.role: ignition orange for lit, open checks and glow
lime for passed checks and the final state
paper for type and the handoff sheet

sound.plan: A driving minor pulse bed at 120 BPM, one bar per two seconds, with hits on each scene cut, a rise into the open check and a closing cadence

lines: Decisions, remaining work, where to resume.
It reads the packet and the project goals first.

inventions: The subject's name: The lit loop on a signup form task
The example task's four check names: Empty email is rejected, Short password is rejected, Valid signup goes through, Works in a real browser
Which check stays open and its label not verified yet
The layout of the handoff sheet
The wording of the headline copy, written from the README's description of the product
ambition: Kinetic type with real hierarchy, one continuous diagram that changes state instead of cutting between slides, hits locked to the cuts, and a first frame that already reads as LitCodex.
